body:
# MG20 Bounties
An advanced, economy-driven bounty and debt management system designed for SMPs, Factions, and PvP servers. Fully powered by **Vault** and built with a lightweight **SQLite** database for maximum performance and zero lag.

## 🌟 Key Features

* **Dynamic Bounties:** Place a price on your rivals' heads using `/bounty place <player> <amount>`. The stakes have never been higher!
* **Smart Tracking Compass:** Hunt down high-value targets! If a player's bounty exceeds $10,000, bounty hunters can purchase a real-time tracking compass via `/bounty track <player>`.
* **Automated Debt Collector:** If a player places a bounty but goes broke, they fall into debt. A smart background system automatically deducts money as soon as they earn it until the debt is completely cleared.
* **Anti-Exploit System:** Fully secured. Players cannot place bounties on themselves or exploit the system to claim their own bounties.
* **Plug & Play:** No complicated database setups required. The built-in SQLite system handles everything seamlessly.

## ⚙️ Commands & Permissions
* `/bounty place <player> <amount>` - Set a bounty on a target.
* `/bounty track <player>` - Receive a tracking compass for high-value targets.
* `hight-value = >10000 

## 📋 Requirements
* **Java 21** (Supports Minecraft versions `1.21` to `1.26.2`)
* **[Vault](https://dev.bukkit.org/projects/vault)** (Required for all economy transactions)
* An Economy Provider (e.g., EssentialsX)
